englishSteps: Anchor a resistance band low and loop it around the ankle nearest the anchor.
Stand upright and hold a support if needed; keep the working knee straight.
Draw the working leg toward the midline against the band, then return slowly and repeat on the other side.
Band_Hip_Adductions.instructionCorrectionReason: Original name and photos indicate hip adduction, but upstream instructions describe abduction; user chose the original name.

englishSteps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Lower into a squat while bringing your straight arms together in front of you.
Stand up while opening your arms back out to the sides.
Rest your forearms on the pads and hold the handles, keeping your back against the support.
Raise your bent knees in front of you without swinging.
Lower your legs under control to the starting position.
Knee_Hip_Raise_On_Parallel_Bars.instructionCorrectionReason: Original name and photos show a bent-knee raise; upstream steps describe raising straight legs.

englishSteps: Stand upright and hold a stable support with both hands.
Lift one straight leg behind you while keeping your torso steady.
Lower the leg under control and repeat on the other side.
Leg_Lift.instructionCorrectionReason: Source photos show straight-leg hip extension, while its text compares the movement to a leg curl.

englishSteps: Stand between the handles of the leverage machine, bend your knees and grip the lower handles.
Extend your knees and hips to stand, keeping your arms straight.
Bend your knees and hips to lower the handles under control.
Leverage_Deadlift.instructionCorrectionReason: Source instructions omit the lifting phase shown in the original photos.

englishSteps: Place a kettlebell in front of you, hinge at the hips and grip the handle with one hand.
Hike the kettlebell back between your legs, then drive through your hips and legs to swing it forward to approximately chest height.
Let the kettlebell swing back between your legs as you hinge again. Repeat with the other hand.
Hold the bar across the front of your shoulders and stand tall.
Dip slightly at the knees with an upright torso, then drive forcefully through your legs.
Use the leg drive to press the bar overhead, then lower it under control to your shoulders.
Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor and your legs extended.
Raise your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to feet.
Lower your hips with control and repeat, then switch sides.
Lie on your side with your legs extended and your top hand behind your head.
Raise your top leg and curl your upper body toward it at the same time.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch sides.
Stand upright with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your slightly bent arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Move the dumbbells forward at shoulder height, then lower them under control.
Side_Laterals_to_Front_Raise.instructionCorrectionReason: The original title specifies a lateral-to-front raise, but the first raise in the upstream instructions incorrectly says to raise forward.

englishSteps: Place a bench behind the Smith machine and position the bar across your upper back.
Unrack the bar, place one foot forward and rest the other foot on the bench behind you.
Bend the front knee and lower under control, then stand up and repeat on the other side.
Smith_Single-Leg_Split_Squat.instructionCorrectionReason: The source asserts that any knee movement beyond the toes is incorrect and harmful; this blanket claim is unsupported.

englishSteps: Lean your chest against the inclined side of a preacher bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang down, then bend your elbows and curl the dumbbells upward.
Lower the dumbbells under control, keeping your upper arms steady.
Spider_Curl.instructionCorrectionReason: The source name is generic, while its photos and accompanying exercise video show dumbbells rather than the EZ bar described in the source text.

englishSteps: Position the bar across your upper back and lift it from the rack.
Bend your knees and hips to descend into a controlled squat.
Drive through your feet and extend your legs to stand up.
Barbell_Squat.instructionCorrectionReason: The source incorrectly asserts that any forward knee travel beyond the toes makes the squat harmful.

englishSteps: Stand with your back to a stable bench and rest one foot on it behind you.
Keep the supporting knee slightly bent and your torso upright.
Hold a comfortable stretch in the front of the raised leg, then switch sides.
Standing_Elevated_Quad_Stretch.instructionCorrectionReason: The source gives an absolute instruction to prevent the knee moving beyond the toes; forward knee travel is not inherently incorrect.

englishSteps: Secure the straps low, place your feet in the handles and assume a strong high plank.
Bend your knees and draw them toward your torso while maintaining shoulder support.
Slowly extend your legs and return to the plank.
Suspended_Reverse_Crunch.instructionCorrectionReason: The source asks for anterior pelvic tilt while flexing the spine during the crunch; the revised instructions describe the movement without that conflicting cue.

englishSteps: Hold the handles of securely anchored straps and lean back with your arms extended.
Bend your elbows and draw your shoulder blades together as you pull your chest toward the handles.
Slowly straighten your arms while keeping your body aligned.
Suspended_Row.instructionCorrectionReason: The upstream text incorrectly instructs scapular protraction during the pull; the shoulders retract as the body approaches the handles.

englishSteps: Position the bar across your upper back and lift it from the rack.
Set your feet wider than shoulder width and descend into a controlled squat.
Drive through your feet and extend your legs to stand up.
Wide_Stance_Barbell_Squat.instructionCorrectionReason: The source incorrectly claims that knee travel beyond the toes always makes the squat harmful.

englishSteps: Position the bar in the crooks of your elbows and lift it from the rack.
Bend your knees and hips to descend into a controlled squat, keeping the bar secure.
Drive through your feet and extend your legs to stand up.
Zercher_Squats.instructionCorrectionReason: The source incorrectly claims that any knee travel beyond the toes makes the squat harmful.

englishSteps: Rest the bar across the fronts of your shoulders and hold it with crossed arms.
Unrack the bar and descend into a controlled squat with a stable torso.
Extend your legs and return to standing.
Front_Barbell_Squat.instructionCorrectionReason: The upstream text asserts that any knee travel beyond the toes is necessarily harmful; that blanket claim is unsupported.

englishSteps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Bend your knees and hips to descend into a controlled squat.
Drive through your feet and extend your legs to stand up.
Dumbbell_Squat.instructionCorrectionReason: The upstream text asserts that any knee travel beyond the toes is necessarily harmful; that blanket claim is unsupported.

englishSteps: Place the bar across your upper back and lift it from the rack.
Step forward with one leg and bend both knees to lower into a lunge.
Push through your front foot to return to standing, then repeat on the other side.
Barbell_Lunge.instructionCorrectionReason: The upstream text asserts that any knee travel beyond the toes is necessarily harmful; that blanket claim is unsupported.

englishSteps: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward with one leg and bend both knees to lower into a lunge.
Push through your front foot to return to standing, then repeat on the other side.
Dumbbell_Lunges.instructionCorrectionReason: The upstream text asserts that any knee travel beyond the toes is necessarily harmful; that blanket claim is unsupported.

englishSteps: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step backward with one leg and bend both knees to lower into a lunge.
Push through your front foot to return to standing, then repeat on the other side.
Dumbbell_Rear_Lunge.instructionCorrectionReason: The upstream text asserts that any knee travel beyond the toes is necessarily harmful; that blanket claim is unsupported.

englishSteps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing the cable machine.
Pull the rope toward your face, separating your hands and directing your elbows outward.
Extend your arms under control to return the rope forward.
Face_Pull.instructionCorrectionReason: The source contains a single abbreviated instruction; the revision adds setup and controlled return.

englishSteps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet secured, holding a weight plate with both hands in front of you.
Lean back slightly and turn your torso and the plate to one side.
Turn under control to the other side and continue alternating.
Russian_Twist.instructionCorrectionReason: The source name is generic and the photos show a weight plate, which is omitted from the source equipment and instructions.

englishSteps: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a clean-width overhand grip, knees slightly bent and torso inclined forward.
Extend the legs and hips to accelerate the bar close to the body.
Pull under the bar, turn the elbows forward and receive it across the shoulders in a squat.
Stand up and lower the bar under control.
Hang_Clean.instructionCorrectionReason: The original instructions omit pulling under the bar and receiving it at the shoulders.

englishSteps: Lie on your side on a flat bench with a dumbbell in your upper hand.
Lower the arm in front of your torso with a slight bend in the elbow.
Raise the dumbbell in an arc toward the ceiling, then lower it under control.
Repeat on the other side.
Lying_One-Arm_Lateral_Raise.instructionCorrectionReason: The generic original name and photographs show a side-lying raise, while the original text describes a prone rear raise.

englishSteps: Adjust the squat machine, lie back against the pad and place your shoulders under the supports.
Place your feet about shoulder-width apart on the platform and hold the handles.
Press through the whole foot to extend the legs, then bend the knees and return slowly to a comfortable depth.
Lying_Machine_Squat.instructionCorrectionReason: The source instruction imposes an unsupported universal restriction on knees passing toes.

englishSteps: Lie on your back, hold the kettlebell above your shoulder with a straight arm and bend the knee on the same side.
Use your free hand to raise your torso, transfer your weight to your feet and move into a squat.
Stand up from the squat while keeping the kettlebell above your shoulder.
Reverse the sequence to return to the floor and repeat on the other side.
Kettlebell_Turkish_Get-Up_Squat_style.instructionCorrectionReason: The original squat-style name specifies a squat, but the original instructions incorrectly call for a lunge.

englishSteps: Place the Smith machine bar across your shoulders and position your heels on a stable platform with the forefeet extending beyond its edge.
Raise the forefeet while keeping the heels supported and the knees still.
Lower the forefeet under control and repeat.
Smith_Machine_Reverse_Calf_Raises.instructionCorrectionReason: The original instructions incorrectly describe the calf as the contracting muscle during ankle dorsiflexion.

englishSteps: Support yourself on a bench with one hand and the knee on the same side, and hold a dumbbell in the other hand.
Bring the working upper arm alongside the torso with the elbow bent.
Keep the upper arm still, straighten the elbow behind you and lower the forearm under control.
Repeat with the other arm.
Tricep_Dumbbell_Kickback.instructionCorrectionReason: The generic original name and photographs show a one-arm bench-supported kickback, while the original instructions describe two dumbbells without support.

englishSteps: Choose a bicycle that fits, adjust the saddle and wear a properly fitted helmet.
Check the brakes and tires before riding.
Sit on the bicycle, hold the handlebars and pedal at a comfortable pace.
Bicycling.instructionCorrectionReason: The original instruction only describes sitting on a bicycle and omits the activity itself.

englishSteps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides a short distance, using only the bottom portion of a lateral raise.
Lower the weights under control while keeping the torso still.
